exclusion_detail: The key precursor 'compound 2' (and 1) is made 'by a literature-based method [28]' with no procedure in the paper, and the only procedure given (H2SO4 / drop of NH3 on compound 2) cannot be tied to a defined reactant structure. The lead 3g is also internally inconsistent: its heading repeats the 4-methoxyphenyl name of 3f while its NMR, formula (C19H22N8S2) and Figure 2 R-group list indicate the 4-dimethylaminophenyl compound.

lead.label: 3g
lead.why: Abstract: 'In cytotoxic activity, the compound 3g (IC50 24.5 uM) is slightly active ...'; 3g also the docking highlight (-7.7 kcal/mol). (3c is named for antibacterial activity; the title and the follow-up docking point to 3g.)

notes: Sections 2.2, 2.3, 4.1, Figure 2 of the article (no SI). Figure 2 conditions: (i) thiosemicarbazide/DMSO, (ii) H2SO4/NH3, (iii) NaOH/dil. HCl; steps (i) and the origin of compounds 1 and 2 are only referred to literature. Also the stated amount '0.01 mol, 4.09 g' of compound 2 does not match any product here.
